rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a proposition or position that is completely opposite to another.

example.english: You argue for tax cuts and I argue for tax increases; my position is the antithesis of yours.
example.traditional: 你主張減稅，我主張加稅，我嘅立場就係你嘅相反嘅主張。
example.jyutping: nei5 zyu2 zoeng1 gaam2 seoi3 ngo5 zyu2 zoeng1 gaa1 seoi3 ngo5 ge3 lap6 coeng4 zau6 hai6 nei5 ge3 soeng1 faan2 ge3 zyu2 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this for the rhetorical contrast between two ideas, rather than for one opposite proposition.

example.english: The author places life and death side by side, creating a striking antithesis.
example.traditional: 作者將生與死並排寫，造成好強烈嘅對比。
example.jyutping: zok3 ze2 zoeng1 saang1 jyu5 sei2 bing6 paai4 se2 zou6 sing4 hou2 koeng4 lit6 ge3 deoi3 bei2

rows.note: Use this as the more technical term for contrasting ideas arranged in parallel rhetorical form.

example.english: The essay uses antithesis to arrange gain and loss in parallel phrases.
example.traditional: 篇文用對偶，將得同失排成平行句式。
example.jyutping: pin1 man4 jung6 deoi3 ngau5 zoeng1 dak1 tung4 sat1 paai4 sing4 ping4 hang4 geoi3 sik1
